_about: Transit under construction (engine/construction.py). Lines come from OpenStreetMap ways whose name matches 'match' (engine/fetch_construction.py); stations from OSM where mapped. Only facts the MTA has published go in 'opens'. Penn Station Access (Metro-North to Penn Station with four new Bronx stations) runs on existing Amtrak track, so it isn't drawn as a new line yet.

lines.name: Second Avenue Subway, Phase 2
lines.about: Extends the Q train north from 96th Street along Second Avenue and across 125th Street to Lexington Avenue, with new stations at 106th, 116th and 125th Streets.
